move: squares drop column by column with squash bounce, ripple, fall through
how: Thirty-two 72px rounded squares in an 8x4 grid, randomly black, yellow, blue, red or green (seeded rng). Each drops from y -900 over 1.2s with a CustomBounce 'drop' ease (strength .5, squash 2) while a matching scaleY .6 / scaleX 1.35 squash tween runs on the 'drop-squash' ease, staggered 50ms across the grid on the x axis so columns land left to right. A title line rises from its mask at 20%. At 40% a ripple from the grid centre shrinks each square to 0.72 and rotates 90deg and back (power2.inOut yoyo, 40ms grid stagger); at 62% a second ripple from the far corner rotates 45deg and back. At 82% the squares fall through the floor (y 520, opacity 0, power3.in, 30ms stagger) and the title drops out.
adapt: Change the grid dimensions, square size and radius, palette and the title; the rng seed changes the colour scatter. Keep the CustomBounce strength/squash pairing and the 50ms x-axis stagger.
port: mount(el, shot) creates the grid of squares inside el with seeded colours. animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline with grid:[rows,cols] staggers and CustomBounce.create called once (guard against re-creating the ease name).
caveats: needs CustomEase and CustomBounce; drop-squash ease is created alongside drop
from() drop tween needs immediateRender:false if built late
ends on an empty stage, loop restarts with the drop
